name: karni-site
summary: Public websites for Karni: every text, image and menu editable in the admin, public forms, redirects, and error pages that cannot fail. Karni is an open-source Django + React framework for building with AI coding agents. Your agent writes only your domain. The API, admin, permissions and React screens come from a package you upgrade, not code it rewrites in each project. One rule set covers every coding agent. The build fails when an agent hand-writes what Karni ships.
